text: Plant protein? Bro, you can't build muscle eating grass!
Pea, rice, and soy protein can all build muscle. Single plant sources are just a bit lower in leucine.
Blends like pea and rice fill that gap, and studies show results similar to whey when the protein is matched.
Pick a blend, or use a slightly bigger scoop. Great if you're vegan, or dairy upsets your stomach.
